name: empty
description: An organization where `source:sample source_count:1` matches nothing -- the steady state once this integration has been running for a while and has already cleaned up. exportAssetsJSON streams a literal `[` before the first row and `]` after the last, so zero rows is the two-byte body `[]`. That distinction is load-bearing here because, unlike the other runZero-sourced integrations in this repo, this script decodes the body with json_decode directly rather than through get_json, and Starlark has no exception handling: a body json_decode cannot parse aborts the entire run rather than returning an error. The run must complete having made exactly one request, scheduled no scan, and -- above all -- issued no bulk delete, since an empty asset_ids list is rejected by the API as a 404 and a delete with the wrong contents is unrecoverable.
